prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1465; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving your insured. Please direct all future communications regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We ask that you immediately disclose the full liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage, and provide a copy of the declarations page. We also request written confirmation of the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

Please take steps now to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim file notes, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We expect a substantive response within thirty days of receipt of this letter.
